# dsh-infinite-canvas
English | 简体中文
Operate saved Infinite Canvas projects directly from DeepSeek Harness through a user API Key. An ind
ependent optional launcher starts the local Agent for the canvas web app.
## Quick start

1. Install the plugin bundle from `https://github.com/TNTest/dsh-infinite-canvas`.
2. Open **Setting

s → Infinite Canvas**. The default deployment is `https://infic.transiglobal.com`.
3. Create a dedic
ated `ic_` user Key in the canvas site's **Account → API Key**, paste it into the plugin, then choos
e **Verify & save**. Reading needs `read`; canvas edits need `read + write`; generation needs `gener

ate`; deleting resources needs `delete`.
4. Ask Harness to list, create or edit a canvas. Backend to
ols work with the browser closed and the local Agent stopped. The bundled `infinite-canvas` skill is

registered automatically.
5. **View canvases** is optional. If the page is already open, save its e
dits before API operations and reload it afterwards to see saved changes.
No browser-console login token is needed. API authentication does not sign the browser into the webs
rowser-console login token is needed. API authentication does not sign the browser into the website.
## Two independent paths
| Path | Purpose | Requirements |
| Backend API tools | Saved canvases, nodes, connections, groups, layout and backend media tasks | D

eployment URL and API Key |
| Optional web-Agent launcher | Start/stop the local Agent used by the a
ssistant in the canvas web app | Node.js 22+, `npx`, and an open canvas page when using that assista
tant in the canvas web app | Node.js 22+, `npx`, and an open canvas page when using that assistant |
The launcher retains automatic startup, a configurable local address and **Open web app with Agent**
. Its default command is `npx -y @tigerowo/canvas-agent@latest`; the first start may download depend
encies. The Agent's connection token is read automatically and used only for an explicitly requested
web handshake. It is independent of the user API Key.
Creating or editing a canvas never opens or switches browser tabs. The plugin no longer uses a stdio
MCP bridge for backend editing. The old `infinite-canvas-mcp` row ships disabled for upgrades; disa
ble any old profile override that explicitly enables it. The web Agent does not need that Harness MC
y old profile override that explicitly enables it. The web Agent does not need that Harness MCP row.
## Agent tools
| Tool | Actions |

| `infinite_canvas_status` | Check backend connectivity independently from the optional launcher |
|
`infinite_canvas_projects` | `list`, `create`, `rename`, `delete`; `open` only returns a plain view

ing URL |
| `infinite_canvas_nodes` | `summary`, `query`, `get`, `upstream`, `downstream`, `connecte
d`; `create_text`, `create_primary_script`, `create_media`, `update_text`, `rename`, `move`, `delete

`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `group`, `arrange` |
| `infinite_canvas_catalog` | Public models/channel

s, saved workflows, personal/system skills and system skill files |
| `infinite_canvas_media` | `sub
mit`, read-only `status`, `sync` result into a node, `stop` a backend task |
Every node/media call names a `canvasId`. Reads return `project.revision`; node edits, project renam
e/delete and media submit/sync require a fresh `expectedRevision`. Writes preserve unrelated project
fields and read back the result. Writes from this plugin are serialized per canvas, and known stale
revisions are rejected. **The current backend has no atomic compare-and-swap**, so simultaneous bro
wser/API editing can still race; do not treat these checks as collaborative real-time synchronizatio
er/API editing can still race; do not treat these checks as collaborative real-time synchronization.
Node deletion cleans graph edges, group/batch membership and stale chat media references, but retain
s actual files, backend tasks and generation history. Grouping does not support nested groups or bat
ch nodes; individual batch movement and batch layout remain web-app functions. There is no API equiv
alent of a mouse selection, unsaved browser state, local Codex session or private browser model conf
mouse selection, unsaved browser state, local Codex session or private browser model configuration.
## Backend media tasks
Prepare an image, video or audio node with `create_media`; this never starts generation. `submit` ne
eds an explicit backend `channelId` and a `request` JSON object containing `model` and the provider'
s required parameters. The Key is never placed in that object. Image-edit JSON requests can use `edi
t: true` with explicitly supplied references.
`status` only reads the task; `sync` writes its current status and primary result URL/media metadata
into the node. Additional result URLs remain in the task response; sync does not recreate the web a
pp's batch-result UI. Workflows can be discovered, but workflow execution, multipart uploads, browse
r-local providers and arbitrary model-specific parameter translation are not implemented by this too
local providers and arbitrary model-specific parameter translation are not implemented by this tool.
Generation requires the user's authorization and can consume credits. Submission IDs are saved befor
e sending the request; submitted nodes cannot be submitted again. On an uncertain timeout, query the
retained task ID rather than retrying. Stop requests are not deletion or guaranteed refunds. Permis
sions, provider payloads and availability still apply even when the canvas itself is editable.
## Credentials and local files

- UI settings: `$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/settings.json`.
- API Key: `$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/canv
as-api.json`, mode `0600`, bound to its verified deployment URL. `CANVAS_API_KEY` can override it fo

r the deployment in the plugin row configuration.
- Optional web-Agent token: `~/.infinite-canvas/co
dex-agent.json`; redacted launcher log: `$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/agent.log`.
The Key is sent only in the `Authorization` header, never in links or tool output. Remote deployment
s require HTTPS; localhost HTTP is allowed for testing. Authenticated requests do not follow redirec
ts. Changing the deployment makes its old saved Key unavailable until a Key is verified for the new
Changing the deployment makes its old saved Key unavailable until a Key is verified for the new URL.
